remediation_note: Version 3.0.0 remediates PREPRINT-29 v2.0.0 through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline: (1) re-executed partitioned Edge-Linked ModelTest vs. Unpartitioned ML (zero estimation distortion / proper Table 3A ranking) and fixed benchmark clade evaluation via china_australia_pests_preprint29_design.json; (2) enforced homogeneous single-family Code-1 nuclear ortholog curation purging truncated/paralogous ace-1, CSP, Hsp70, and Cys-loop-incomplete CYP6 sequences (12/12 full-length I-helix + Cys-loop CYP6 orthologs retained on 1TQN); (3) isolated contaminated L2 (28S), L3 (ace-1), L6 (intron-free CYP6 mRNA), and R1/R6 (COII/CYTB-free COX1) skyline caches with fresh v3 keys eliminating ESS < 200 and Rhat > 1.05 plateaus; and (4) eliminated all-gap S3 COX1 rows and enforced metadata hygiene.

calibrated_nodes.key_enzymes_or_loci: Swarming CSP/OBP plasticity & arid Hsp70 thermotolerance
calibrated_nodes.ecosystem_role: Long-distance locust outbreak & steppe pasture guild

calibrated_nodes.ecosystem_role: Convergent phloem feeding, tospovirus/begomovirus & hopper transmission

calibrated_nodes.clade_name: Crown Holometabola: Coleoptera Curculionidae [D] vs. Panorpida [E-G]
calibrated_nodes.fossil_or_biogeo_anchor: Carboniferous Aparaglossata Beetle-Panorpida split (McKenna et al. 2019 [4]; Misof et al. 2014 [2])
calibrated_nodes.key_enzymes_or_loci: Ambrosia mycangial Fusarium transport & grain hypoxia GST/CYP6
calibrated_nodes.ecosystem_role: Holometabolous larval niche shielding & timber biosecurity bridge

calibrated_nodes.ecosystem_role: Emergent WA Perth & South China urban/avocado tree borer complex

calibrated_nodes.clade_name: Crown Panorpida / Mecopterida: Diptera Tephritidae [E] vs. Lepidoptera [F-G]
calibrated_nodes.fossil_or_biogeo_anchor: Carboniferous-Permian Antliophora/Diptera vs. Amphiesmenoptera split (Wiegmann et al. 2011 [6]; Misof et al. 2014 [2])
calibrated_nodes.trophic_guild: Quarantine frugivorous fruit flies (Bactrocera tryoni, Ceratitis capitata, B. dorsalis)
calibrated_nodes.key_enzymes_or_loci: CYP6 fruit-terpene clearance & ace-1 organophosphate variants

calibrated_nodes.clade_name: Crown Lepidoptera Ditrysia: Yponomeutoidea [F] vs. Obtectomera [G]
calibrated_nodes.fossil_or_biogeo_anchor: Jurassic-Early Cretaceous Ditrysia diversification (Kawahara et al. 2019 [7]; Landry & Hebert 2013 [19])
calibrated_nodes.trophic_guild: Brassicaceae specialist moths (Plutella xylostella, P. australiana)
calibrated_nodes.key_enzymes_or_loci: Glucosinolate sulfatase, diamide RyR & Bt resistance loci
calibrated_nodes.ecosystem_role: Cosmopolitan vs. endemic Australia brassica pest divergence

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Comparative Scope Across China & Australia Agricultural Agroecosystems
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Agricultural trade, monsoon wind corridors, and protected-crop intensification across East Asia and Oceania link sixteen major arthropod pest complexes spanning both China and Australia, uniting Chelicerata outgroup spider mites (Tetranychus urticae, T. truncatus, T. kanzawai, Panonychus citri), Polyneoptera migratory locusts (Locusta migratoria, Chortoicetes terminifera), Paraneoptera thrips, whiteflies, aphids, and planthoppers (Frankliniella occidentalis, Bemisia tabaci, Trialeurodes vaporariorum, Nilaparvata lugens), Coleoptera ambrosia/grain beetles (Euwallacea fornicatus, Sitophilus oryzae), Diptera quarantine Tephritidae fruit flies (Bactrocera tryoni, B. dorsalis, Ceratitis capitata), and Lepidoptera brassica and noctuid/crambid defoliators (Plutella xylostella, P. australiana, Spodoptera frugiperda, Helicoverpa armigera, H. punctigera).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v3.0.0, all 64 stratified pest OTUs execute end-to-end through the generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor and bio-suite-seqnet pipeline with Edge-Linked Partitioned ModelTest vs. Unpartitioned ML estimator parity, China-Australia benchmark clade recovery validation (china_australia_pests_preprint29_design.json), clean COX1 codon phasing excluding all-gap rows, homogeneous single-family Code-1 nuclear ortholog curation across ace-1, CSP, Hsp70, and I-helix + Cys-loop CYP6 monooxygenases, and fresh converged v3 skyline caches across all 12 regional and multi-locus cohorts.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Autonomous Data Hygiene, >=80% Supermatrix Coverage Gate, Circular COX1 Phasing & Chronogram Inference
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Multispecies Coalescent Species Tree, ABBA-BABA Signals & 32-Chain RuNIE Comparison
manuscript_prose.section4_title: Xenobiotic Resistance vs. Plasticity Selection (ace-1, CSP, Hsp70 & CYP6 on 1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Universal Standard Code 1 arthropod nuclear coding alignments passing strict pre-MSA motif and post-MSA codon auditing, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify selective constraint on organophosphate/carbamate target-site acetylcholinesterase (FAM-01: ace-1 with active-site FGE.AG), chemosensory host-finding proteins (FAM-02: CSP), thermal/diapause chaperone (FAM-03: Hsp70 with ATPase IFDLGGG/VFDLGGG), and Clan-3 xenobiotic detoxification cytochrome P450s (FAM-04: CYP6 with conserved I-helix and Cys-loop FxxGxxxCxG) threaded onto crystal template PDB 1TQN (2.05 A).
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Cross-Regional Skylines, Diploid 28S/ITS1 Buffering & Stage 3C Radiative-Forcing Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Comparative phylogenomic reconstruction across China and Australia demonstrates how deeply divergent arthropod lineages—spanning Paleozoic Chelicerata-Mandibulata origins through Mesozoic-Paleogene insect radiations—converge repeatedly on shared agrarian host-use and detoxification architectures. While endemic Australian species such as Bactrocera tryoni, Helicoverpa punctigera, Plutella australiana, and Chortoicetes terminifera preserve structured, regionally anchored coalescence across arid and tropical-subtropical biomes, cosmopolitan pests including Spodoptera frugiperda, Bemisia tabaci, Helicoverpa armigera, Plutella xylostella, Frankliniella occidentalis, and Tetranychus urticae exhibit compact star-like mitochondrial clusters consistent with human-assisted transport and monsoon-driven gene flow.

Re-executing Stage 4 under strict single-family Code-1 ortholog QC eliminated truncated Hsp70 fragments and Cys-loop-incomplete CYP6 paralogs, yielding 12/12 full-length heme-thiolate CYP6 orthologs aligned cleanly on 1TQN while isolating COII/CYTB fragments, genomic introns, and non-homologous rRNA caches from Stage 3B multi-locus skyline inference (12/12 cohorts converged at minESS >= 200 and maxRhat <= 1.05).

Cross-validation against china_australia_pests_preprint29_design.json paired with 64-species Quartet MSC and calibrated TimeTreeLSD2 node bounds establishes a reproducible dry-lab phylogenomic baseline bounded by public GenBank availability and empirical sampling density across East Asian and Australian monitoring programs.
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Sixteen major China and Australia agricultural arthropod pest complexes spanning Chelicerata Acari [A] through Hexapoda [B]-[G] are jointly evaluated across 16 loci and 4 nuclear resistance families in Version 3.0.0.
